rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a subcontinent, including a large subregion such as the Indian subcontinent.

example.english: The Indian subcontinent is made up of many countries and has a very diverse culture.
example.traditional: 印度次大陸由好多國家組成，文化非常多元。
example.jyutping: jan3 dou6 ci3 daai6 luk6 jau4 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 zou2 sing4 man4 faa3 fei1 soeng4 do1 jyun4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when the context makes the South Asian region clear.

example.english: We’re travelling around the subcontinent this time and want to try the local street food.
example.traditional: 我哋今次去南亞旅行，想試吓當地嘅街頭小食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 heoi3 naam4 aa3 leoi5 hang4 soeng2 si3 haa5 dong1 dei6 ge3 gaai1 tau4 siu2 sik6

rows.note: Use this formal geographic name when you need to specify the Indian subcontinent itself rather than South Asia generally.

example.english: This book gives a detailed introduction to the geography and history of the Indian subcontinent.
example.traditional: 呢本書詳細介紹印度次大陸嘅地理同歷史。
example.jyutping: nei1 bun2 syu1 coeng4 sai3 gaai3 siu6 jan3 dou6 ci3 daai6 luk6 ge3 dei6 lei5 tung4 lik6 si2
